metadata.directionPolicy: For manifestation -> concept, broadMatch means the target concept is broader; narrowMatch means the target concept is narrower.
metadata.reviewPolicy: Discovery mappings do not authorize aggregation; aggregationSafe is false until operational equivalence is established.

concepts.label: Early antenatal-care registration
concepts.definition: Registration of a pregnancy during the source-defined early or first-trimester period among registered pregnancies.

mappings.rationale: The HMIS measure represents early registration but its operational timing and reporting denominator remain source-version dependent.
The scorecard expresses first-trimester registration among total ANC registrations; source-table computation detail is limited.
differences: source table does not publish full operational exclusions

concepts.label: Three antenatal check-ups
concepts.definition: Completion of at least three antenatal check-ups among the source-defined registered pregnancy population.

mappings.rationale: The HMIS rate uses total ANC registered as denominator and the historic three-check-up schedule.
The scorecard label describes the same broad construct but does not preserve complete operational exclusions.

concepts.label: Institutional delivery
concepts.definition: Births occurring in health institutions among the source-defined delivery or pregnancy population.

mappings.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to public facilities, so the target concept is broader.
The construct aligns, but estimated deliveries and routine reporting differ from scorecard populations.
The numerator is institutional deliveries but the denominator is total ANC registration rather than estimated deliveries.

concepts.label: Skilled birth attendance
concepts.definition: Deliveries attended by source-defined skilled health personnel.

mappings.rationale: Routine reported deliveries and the HMIS cadre definition differ from survey assessment.
The survey-based manifestation uses births assessed by a survey and a specified cadre list.

concepts.label: Neonatal mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths during the neonatal period per 1,000 live births in the source-defined population and period.

mappings.rationale: Routine reported neonatal deaths may not represent all population deaths and must not be pooled with survey estimates.
The same rate concept is represented through a survey scorecard with different ascertainment and reference period.

concepts.label: Contraceptive use or prevalence
concepts.definition: Use of source-defined contraceptive methods among the source-defined eligible population.

mappings.rationale: Routine service reporting uses eligible couples and all methods as defined by HMIS.
This manifestation is limited to modern methods and its programme-defined eligible population.
The manifestation is restricted to married adolescents, so it is narrower than the target concept.

concepts.label: Early postnatal care
concepts.definition: Postnatal contact within the source-defined early period after delivery among eligible mothers or births.

mappings.rationale: The manifestation specifies care within two days for the last birth and a survey-defined provider group.

concepts.label: Low birth weight
concepts.definition: Live births below the source-defined birth-weight threshold among births weighed.

mappings.rationale: The denominator includes only live births weighed, so missing birth weights affect interpretation.

concepts.label: Adolescent anaemia
concepts.definition: Anaemia among adolescents tested or assessed under a source-defined haemoglobin threshold.

mappings.rationale: Any anaemia is one severity formulation within the broader anaemia concept.
Severe anaemia is one severity formulation within the broader anaemia concept.
